excerpt_original: Robert Daniels and Inney Prakash debate new films from Radu Jude, Marie Kreutzer, and Ryûsuke Hamaguchi

blocks.text: Cannes 2026 has arrived, and the Film Comment crew is on the ground, ready to cut through the noise with dispatches, interviews, Podcasts, a special Cannes Critics’ Grid, and much more. This year’s edition is packed with highly anticipated premieres from Pedro Almodóvar, Valeska Grisebach, James Gray, Paweł Pawlikowski, and many more acclaimed filmmakers.

For the third of our daily Podcasts from the Croisette, critic Robert Daniels (RogerEbert.com) and FC Contributing Editor and Asia Society programmer Inney Prakash join to discuss Radu Jude’s The Diary of a Chambermaid (3:45), Marie Kreutzer’s Gentle Monster (19:55), and Ryûsuke Hamaguchi’s All of a Sudden (28:16).
Subscribe today to Film Comment to stay up-to-date with all of our Cannes 2026 coverage.
